vivek: Quick check-in: I'm leaning toward emitting tiny, versioned 'route hints' from the policy compiler (intent + numeric targets) and letting adapters score locally. Goal: reduce decision latency without giving adapters full policy control.

tori: Short question: how do we keep decisions auditable? If adapters score, we need reproducibility.

oscar: We pin profile snapshots. Hint includes rationale_id and compiler version; adapter returns profile_snapshot_id used to score. Logs join on those ids for audits.

mari: Sample hint (v1): {"hint_v":1, "intent":"interactive", "p95_ms":150, "cost_per_m_usd":0.001, "rationale_id":"r-778"} — optional field in route manifest.

vivek: Adapter response contract (minimal): {candidates:[{route:,score:,uncertainty:,whyCode}], profile_snapshot:, cid:}. Keep fields short.

tori: Uncertainty semantics need a doc. Proposal: uncertainty = 1 - min(1, sqrt(var)/mean * k) where var/mean from probe window and k calibrated. I'll write appendix.

oscar: Rollout plan idea: 1) compiler emits hints only 2) adapters read hints in sim-mode and write parity logs 3) run parity sims 4) canary small tenant set with double-check against legacy router 5) scale if metrics OK.

mari: Telemetry gates: decision drift <4%, p95 delta <6%, cost delta <5%, uncertainty median not rising. Also require profile_snapshot age < threshold.

vivek: Runtime fallback: pick first candidate with score >= runtime_threshold, else fall back to legacy router, else slow-safe fallback. Adapters can also return 'reject' when they detect stale profiles.

tori: Security note: hints and rationale_id only in control plane. Encrypt manifests at rest and restrict access; strip sensitive fields from low-level logs.

oscar: Ops tasks: parity stream, dashboards, canary list + auto-rollback on alerts. ops-bot: created ticket #ops/route-hints-canary.

mari: Open questions to capture in RFC: exact uncertainty formula (tori), select_threshold defaults, profile snapshot TTL and refresh cadence (oscar), and how many tiers (gold/silver) the compiler should emit.

vivek: Good. 48h RFC draft window; 30m sync after. Thumbs?

tori: +1

oscar: +1

mari: +1
